title: The Man Who Won French Scrabble Without Speaking French
youtube_title: He Won The French Scrabble Championship Without Speaking French! 🇫🇷 🔠 #Shorts
youtube_description:
In 2015, New Zealander Nigel Richards memorized the entire official French dictionary in just 9 weeks—without learning what any word meant! He then entered the World Francophone Scrabble Championship and defeated French grandmasters to take the world title! When the audience gave him a standing ovation, he needed a translator to say thank you! 🇫🇷 🔠

lines.text: A man won the French Scrabble championship without knowing French.
In fact, he could not speak a single word.
Nigel Richards from New Zealand only spoke fluent English.
To challenge himself, he bought the entire French dictionary.
For nine weeks, he memorized three hundred eighty-six thousand words.
He never learned what any of the definitions meant.
He only memorized letter combinations and point values.
Then he flew to Belgium for the World Francophone Championship.
Native French grandmasters stared in disbelief at his impossible moves.
Nigel crushed the tournament and claimed the world championship trophy.
When the French crowd cheered, he needed an interpreter.
Because without even knowing how to say hello...
